sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops the chain when any link is nil — the entire expression collapses to nothing
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any link is gone, the whole reaching resolves to absence.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no match exists on the right, filling unmatched columns with NULL
sketches.resonance: I keep every version of myself in the result, but the places where you should appear are all NULL — you were never there to join.
sketches.draft:
SELECT me.day, you.presence
FROM   every_day me
LEFT JOIN you
  ON me.reaching = you.answer
-- presence: NULL
-- presence: NULL
-- presence: NULL

sketches.mechanism: The `lateinit` modifier promises a variable will be initialized before use, but accessing it before initialization throws UninitializedPropertyAccessException at runtime
sketches.resonance: Some things we declare with absolute faith that they will arrive — and the moment we reach for them too early, everything breaks.
